verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a maintained integration with a RAG or agent framework such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. The integrations shown are embedding providers (OpenAI, OpenCLIP, VoyageAI) and Hugging Face dataset scanning, which belong to different stories. The AI-coding-agent plugin and the time-travel RAG tutorial are adjacent material, not framework integrations, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations
